tasks.title: Asynchronous Gateway Core
tasks.description: Write a standalone Python module named 'resilient_gateway.py' that establishes an async websocket connection loop using asyncio and websockets, featuring exponential backoff and jitter for network resilience.

tasks.title: In-Memory Order Book State Engine
tasks.description: Write a Python module named 'order_book_engine.py' that imports or integrates with the gateway concept to manage an in-memory order book, handling snapshots, delta sorting (bids descending, asks ascending), and sequence-gap validation.

tasks.title: Latency Decoupling and Telemetry
tasks.description: Write a final integration module named 'gateway_terminal.py' that ties the resilient gateway and order book together, using 'asyncio.Lock' to decouple high-frequency data ingestion from background telemetry logging so the primary loop never lags.
